title: George and the Dinosaur Under the Blanket

learning.summary_zh: 睡前 George 與膽小的 Big Eye 發現棉被下有聲響；房間變成夢境，幫迷路的小恐龍 Nibble 找巢；醒來枕邊留下蕨葉。
focus_en: Bedtime words: blanket, whisper, glow, adventure
Observation: footprint, look carefully, I can see
Key phrases: Hold my hand. Stay close to me. You are home now.
tutor_prompts_zh: 問：棉被下面的 thump 是什麼？（小恐龍 Nibble，不是怪獸）
問：Big Eye 很怕的時候，George 說了什麼？（Hold my hand / Look carefully / We can still be brave）
問：他們怎麼找到 nest？（腳印 + 星星夜燈 + Big Eye 幫忙看）
問：醒來後留下什麼證據？（一片小蕨葉）

pages.alt: Daddy reads a bedtime story while George holds Big Eye

lines.text: It was late, and George was tucked under his warm blanket in the big bed.
Daddy sat beside him and opened one more story on the phone.
Just one more chapter, George. Then it is time to sleep.
Can Big Eye listen too? He likes adventures.
Of course. Good night soon, my brave boy.

pages.alt: George hugs Big Eye as the room grows dark

lines.text: Daddy turned off the main light, and the room became quiet and still.
Only the little star night-light glowed softly on the table.
Good night, Daddy.
Sleep well, George. I will see you in the morning.
George pulled Big Eye close and closed his eyes, but he did not let go.

pages.alt: Something thumps under the cream blanket

lines.text: Then, under the cream blanket, something went thump, thump, thump.
George! Did you hear that? Something is moving under the blanket!
I heard it, Big Eye. My feet are still. It is not me.
What if it is a huge monster with sharp teeth?
Wait. Let us look again before we get scared.

pages.alt: Big Eye blinks three times and the room begins to change

lines.text: Big Eye's one big eye opened wide, and he blinked once.
The grey curtains turned silver in the moonlight, and the blanket rose like a little hill.
I can see something… Blink twice… blink three times…
On the third blink, the whole bed began to change.
Whoa! Our room is turning into a dream!

pages.alt: The blanket becomes a mountain with ferns growing beside the sheet

lines.text: The cream blanket became a soft green mountain, and the pillow became a pale cave.
Tiny ferns pushed up beside the sheet, but George could still see his bedroom hiding inside the dream.
I can see footprints on the mountain! Something small ran this way!
Then we should follow them. Stay close to me, Big Eye.
Me? Follow a monster's footprints? Oh no…

pages.alt: George lifts a fold in the blanket mountain while Big Eye hides behind him

lines.text: Another thump came from behind a fold in the blanket mountain.
It is thumping again! I do not want to look!
I will look first. Hold my hand, and breathe slowly.
George bent down carefully and lifted one corner of the blanket hill.
I am holding your hand… I am still looking with my big eye…

pages.alt: A tiny dinosaur peeks out from behind the blanket

lines.text: A tiny dinosaur peeked out with round, worried eyes.
A dinosaur! I knew it! It will eat us!
No, Big Eye. Look carefully. It is no bigger than my knee.
Peep… peep…
Hello, little one. Are you lost? You look very frightened.

pages.alt: Nibble tells George she cannot find her nest

lines.text: Peep! I cannot find my nest!
It can talk! George, it is talking to us!
Do not worry. We will help you. Where did you come from?
I was sleeping under the warm blanket. Then everything moved!
I think the dream moved you, not the other way. We can find your nest together.

pages.alt: George holds the star night-light while Big Eye spots footprints

lines.text: I can see more footprints! They go toward the curtain forest!
Good spotting, Big Eye. You have the best eyes in the dream.
George held the star night-light high, and a tiny beam pointed toward the grey curtains.
My nest smells like warm leaves. I think it is near the pillow cave!
Then that is where we are going. One step at a time.

pages.alt: George and Big Eye walk through the darker curtain forest

lines.text: Near the curtain forest, the dream room grew darker, and Big Eye began to tremble.
It is too dark! What if something big is hiding in there?
We can be quiet, but we can still be brave. Look — I am here.
Big Eye, you found the footprints. That was very brave already.
Really? Then… then I will look one more time.

pages.alt: Nibble curls up in her nest near the pillow cave

lines.text: At last, behind the pillow cave, they found a nest of soft leaves and moonlit threads.
My nest! I can smell the warm leaves!
The little dinosaur climbed in, tucked its nose under one leaf, and gave a happy little hum.
You are home now, Nibble. Sleep well.
George… I was scared, but we did it. I think I am a little brave too.

pages.alt: George wakes up and finds a tiny fern leaf on his blanket

lines.text: In the morning, George woke up in his own bed with Big Eye under his chin.
Good morning, George. Did you sleep well?
I think I had an adventure with Big Eye and a tiny dinosaur.
Did you? Show me.
George lifted the flat blanket. Near his pillow lay one tiny green fern leaf.
It was real… wasn't it?
